source.runtime_match_scope: Exact upstream release corresponding to reported runtime version; Debian package patches/binary not independently matched. Debian source endpoint returned404.

timing_chain.finding: Input packet DTS=mTimecode in microseconds, PTS=mTime in microseconds; duration=mDuration at1589.
For libavcodec61 GetFramePts directly returns AVFrame.pts. It does not use best_effort_timestamp or guess from pkt_dts.
For libavcodec61 Duration returns AVFrame.duration, not deprecated pkt_duration.
The ordinary software-image path passes these exact PTS/duration values to CreateImage; this branch has no realtime lateness drop adjustment.
VideoData uses PTS/duration for presentation and pkt_dts as mTimecode; RecordFrame:1787 uses mTimecode for performance recording.

Wrapper returns broker-restored PTS, and looks up original packet duration/DTS/position by exact PTS in a256-entry ring. Broker DTS is intentionally unknown, original packet DTS remains output metadata.

timing_conclusion: No evidence currently ties original-packet DTS mapping or has_b_frames to the live60fps drops. The packet-DTS association differs from FFmpeg frame.h wording and the timing-ring miss/duplicate cases deserve separate correctness work, but changing DTS/PTS blindly is not justified by this experiment.

drop_and_callback_findings.finding: total frames=presented+dropped; dropped sums decoder,sink,compositor counters. total alone is not proof of rendering throughput.
Expired frames that were never sent to the compositor accumulate droppedSinkFrames.

The sink deliberately throttles persistently late current frames: it sends another after cumulative skipped durations exceed lateness. A fixed latency can keep large drop ratios even when mean decode rate equals source rate.

rVFC presentedFrames advances by selected frameID difference, including IDs skipped between callbacks. The source explicitly says this is not composition count. A60/s metadata delta can coexist with10/s callbacks and large actual drop counts.

bounded_readonly_diagnostics.interpretation: Sample a few times per second with common monotonic timestamps; compare decoder-ahead and sink lateness trends plus decomposed drop deltas. These asynchronous API snapshots do not prove physical HDMI scanout.

prebuffer_design.classification: The Cedar proxy is not VAAPI,V4L2 or Vulkan, so this Firefox implementation reports software decoding and selects default-size rather than hw-accel-size.
prebuffer_design.current_default: media.video-queue.default-size=10; VideoPrerollFrames=floor(queueSize/2*playbackRate+1), capped by decoder max if any.
prebuffer_design.current_startup_at60: 6 frames, approximately100ms; the same six frames provide approximately200ms at30fps.
prebuffer_design.diagnostic_first: Same-format pause about1s then resume or preload without autoplay. Record whether latency and drops disappear and whether the improvement persists; do not seek or modify PTS.
prebuffer_design.conditional_candidate: If the pause test establishes insufficient lead rather than deficient steady throughput, test private-profile default-size20:11-frame startup approximately183ms at60fps and nominal20-frame queue333ms.
prebuffer_design.memory_delta: At most about31.1MB more tightly packed1080p I420 pixel payload for10 additional queue frames, plus allocator/metadata overhead; ordinary RAM, not permission to enlarge kernel DMA quarantine.
prebuffer_design.acceptance: Maintain the same fps,PTS,A/V timeline and drop accounting. Require low sink/compositor drop deltas and stable positive decode lead over long playback plus pause/seek checks. If lateness keeps growing or drops merely recur later, increased buffering is not a fix.
prebuffer_design.throughput_priority: Keep VE400 and backendv5 results separate, retain A76/RDD scheduling comparison, quantify WC copy and IPC/RDD costs. Sustained processing must have margin above60fps; exactly60fps averages cannot reliably recover from stalls.

not_proposed: No PTS or duration offset to disguise lateness.
